candidates.sentence: From Walla Walla to Republic, we’ve been getting donations from retirees, veterans, business owners, farmers…people who want to preserve the American Dream, secure the border, and stop the government from overreaching and overspending.
The most important thing we need to do right now is secure our southern border.
And there is another border we need to protect—the one between lawful and unlawful, civilized and chaotic.

I was born and raised here and have represented Spokane voters in the Legislature and at the county courthouse—yet I am always learning more about wheat and the Snake River dams, about our timber and mining in the north, about veteran’s medical care, about Fairchild, about protecting Social Security and Medicare, about homelessness, crime, and lawbreakers coming into our country.
